I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or seed from the shop, so I will work the soil with compost and manure from my homestead and plant the maize seed I saved from last year's harvest. This plot is small enough that my children and I can weed and harvest it ourselves without hiring help. We have no water pump or canal, so we will wait for the rains. I do not buy sprays either—we can pull weeds by hand if they grow.
